Watcom loop-unrolled strcpy (2-byte-at-a-time do-while with mid-body null check). Replace the whole loop with strcpy() in a .keep.

Watcom raw-offset struct copy (3 consecutive `*(T *)(base + 0xNN) = *(T *)(base + 0xNN);` lines copying a contiguous block). Ghidra lost the struct type; replace the run with a struct assignment or `memcpy(...)` in a .keep (find/create the matching struct type for the block).

Watcom dead self-copy guard: `if (&local_c0 != &local_120)` wraps an unconditional struct copy. Both addresses are stack locals — always different — so the guard never skips. Drop the if-wrapper in a .keep.

Ghidra CONCAT44 reconstruction (stitches narrow values into a wider one) — a Watcom wide-value artifact, not real C. Reduce to the proper form (e.g. sign-extend `(longlong)(int)x`, 64-bit math, or a typed field) in a .keep.

Inlined fast sqrt bit-trick (bias `_DAT_01c7070c`). Ghidra's numeric `(int)` cast is wrong; the asm reinterprets the float's bit pattern. Bias `_DAT_01c7070c` is not a known magic - this may be a sibling-program variant. Confirm against the .asm (SAR/ADD on the float's bits), then express it via a bit-cast helper in a .keep; no named helper is guaranteed to exist in this program.
